author: BlackNova70
body:
• Username - BlackNova70
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? Yes, I was banned for Ban Evasion. I assume that means that a person is using another person's account to get on the server. I have never been banned on this server once.
  • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false? Yes, my history with the server. I would show my screenshots but I was banned so I cannot.
  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned? No, but I was banned for doing something I never did.
  • Have I been caught ban evading? I was punished for this but I don't know why. Two of my friends were banned over a year ago but just unbanned two days ago, February 15. One friend was just temp banned today since he was in a fight with another player. But they're is no credible source to prove that I am ban evading. How can I be ban evading if never banned?
  • Have I appealed a ban before? No since I have never been banned before.
I know for a fact that I did not do anything that violated the rules of the Avicus Network. Here is what happened... So me and my friend, puttputt21, were playing Nebula on the map Rendezvous III. It was around 8:00 EST and I was in a Skype chat with puttputt21. She had to go afk and I was just playing when out of nowhere, Piez banned puttputt21 for ban evasion. She came back from afk and I was politely asking Piez how she was evading. I told him that she was just unbanned a few days ago from another staff member because she served almost two years. I tried to get his attention without spamming him and the next thing I knew, I was banned for Ban Evasion.

I do not understand what I did. I violated NO rules of this server and it is impossible for me to Ban Evade when I have never been banned on this server before. I hope that justice comes forth and I am unbanned because there is just no credible source. 

Thank you very much.

BlackNova70

Thank you
